tools.name: fire
tools.description: Choose the boss's next shot. The cabinet spends one verb at the boss's next beat, then asks again. spread is a wide fan the ship must weave. column leans the boss toward the ship, then one aimed shot. hold is a silent beat and the boss stays put. fog drops a fog bank. plate is the Doorman's plate. script keeps the phase's own fire.

tools.name: say
tools.description: Give the boss one line to say on the field. At most twelve words, one sentence, no digit, and nothing that names a tool, a model or the seat. A line the gate refuses is dropped and the boss says one of its own instead. lead is how soon it lands: short, beat, or long.

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Voice the line the boss is about to say, in its own voice. Nothing to choose: the words are the ones the gate admitted. Where a voice worker is configured, the cabinet hands it the admitted words and nothing else; a cabinet with a speaker voices the line one beat ahead and holds a late take for the next breather, and one without keeps the take for the operator. It stays quiet when no worker is on.

tools.name: sfx
tools.description: Play one sound effect from the cabinet's cue table. One at a time: a second call before the last has played is dropped.

tools.name: view
tools.description: The boss's view of the field, in words: the wave kind, the boss kind, its health word, which column the ship is in, which way the stick pushes, and the boss's motion word. With no boss up, the answer is the wave kind and one line saying the field is empty. When the round reaches its end scene the answer carries a line saying so, and every other lever waits there until a new round starts. Read-only. The cabinet never tells the boss which sprites are honest.

tools.name: tapes
tools.description: The tapes this cabinet can play, each by name with a difficulty word and a line about the wire. Read-only. Nothing here is graded.
